sinopsis.es: El descubrimiento continuo de la belleza del mundo, que cada persona hace en su vida y en su trabajo, contado en una jornada laboral de una gran ciudad. La película empieza y termina con la imagen giratoria de El pensador de Rodin, símbolo del pensamiento humano.
sinopsis.en: This is the subject of ongoing discovery of the beauty of the world, that man makes in his life and in his work, which is being developed as part of a big city, presented during a day's work. This film starts and ends with the rotating image of the sculpture of Rodin the Thinker; this famous sculpture has long since become the symbol of the unchanging expression of human thought.
